literal: Than the friendship of those who are of the joking sort, by enemies ten multiplied by a crore will result.
translation: Ten crore times more good comes from enemies than from the friendship of those who only joke around.
modern: வெறுமனே சிரித்துப் பேசிப் பழகும் தன்மை கொண்டவர்களின் நட்பை விட, பகைவர்களால் பத்து கோடி மடங்கு அதிக நன்மை உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts superficial friends with open enemies. The phrase 'நகைவகையர்' refers to people whose friendship consists only of laughing and joking, lacking true support or sincerity. The poet states that having enemies brings 'பத்து அடுத்த கோடி' (ten crore) times more benefit than having such shallow friends. Enemies, by their open hostility, keep one alert and grounded, whereas false friends offer nothing of substance and can cause unexpected harm.
